methods.label: Determine the sign inside the absolute value
methods.explanation:
Since \(\pi>3\), the number \(3-\pi\) is negative. The absolute value of a negative number is its opposite, so
\[
|3-\pi|=-(3-\pi)=\pi-3.
\]
The exact value is \(\pi-3\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
